entities.name: Yana Alekseevna
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yana Ivanivna Alekseevna, also known as Yana Zavyalova is a Ukrainian-born Azerbaijani boxer. She competed in the women's lightweight event at the 2016 Summer Olympics, where she was defeated in the quarter-finals. In 2014, she won a silver medal at the World Championships.
